H2000.def: a primitive root (compare «01949», «01993»); properly, to put in commotion; by implication, to disturb, drive, destroy:--break, consume, crush, destroy, discomfit, trouble, vex.

H2001.def: of foreign derivation; Haman, a Persian vizier:--Haman.

H2002.def: (Aramaic) but the text is hamuwnek {ham-oo-nayk'}; of foreign origin; a necklace:--chain.

H2003.et: from an unused root apparently meaning to crackle
H2003.def: from an unused root apparently meaning to crackle; a dry twig or brushwood:--melting.

H2004.def: feminine plural from «01931»; they (only used when emphatic):-- × in, such like, (with) them, thereby, therein, (more than) they, wherein, in which, whom, withal.

H2005.def: a primitive particle; lo!; also (as expressing surprise) if:--behold, if, lo, though.

H2006.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «02005»: lo! also there(-fore), (un- )less, whether, but, if:--(that) if, or, whether.

H2007.def: prolongation for «02004»; themselves (often used emphatic for the copula, also in indirect relation):--X in, × such (and such things), their, (into) them, thence, therein, these, they (had), on this side, whose, wherein.

H2008.def: from «02004»; hither or thither (but used both of place and time):--here, hither(-to), now, on this (that) side, + since, this (that) way, thitherward, + thus far, to...fro, + yet.

H2010.def: from «05117»; permission of rest, i.e. quiet:--release.

H2011.def: probably of foreign origin; Hinnom, apparently a Jebusite:--Hinnom.

H2012.def: probably of foreign derivation; Hena, a place apparently in Mesopotamia:--Hena.

H2013.def: a primitive root; to hush:--hold peace (tongue), (keep) silence, be silent, still.

H2015.def: a primitive root; to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert:--X become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).

H2016.def: : or hephek {hay'-fek}; from «02015»; a turn, i.e. the reverse:--contrary.

H2017.def: from «02015»; an upset, i.e. (abstract) perversity:--turning of things upside down.

H2021.et: from an unused root meaning apparently to be sharp or strong
H2021.def: from an unused root meaning apparently to be sharp or strong; a weapon of war:--chariot.

H2022.def: a shortened form of «02042»; a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively):--hill (country), mount(-ain), × promotion.

H2023.def: another form of «02022»; mountain; Hor, the name of a peak in Idumaea and of one in Syria:--Hor.

H2024.def: perhaps from «02022»; mountainousness; Hara, a region of Media:--Hara.

H2025.def: from «02022» and «0410»; mount of God; figuratively, the altar of burnt-offering:--altar. Compare «0739».

H2026.def: a primitive root; to smite with deadly intent:--destroy, out of hand, kill, murder(-er), put to (death), make (slaughter), slay(-er), × surely.

H2029.def: a primitive root; to be (or become) pregnant, conceive (literally or figuratively):--been, be with child, conceive, progenitor.

H2030.def: or hariy (Hosea 14:1) {haw-ree'}; from «02029»; pregnant:--(be, woman) with child, conceive, × great.

H2031.def: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to «02029»; a mental conception:--thought.

H2033.def: another form for «02043»; a Harorite or mountaineer:--Harorite.

H2036.et: from an unused root (meaning to tower up)
H2036.def: from an unused root (meaning to tower up); high; Horam, a Canaanitish king:--Horam.

H2037.et: pass. participle of the same as (02036)
H2037.def: passive participle of the same as «02036»; high; Harum, an Israelite:--Harum.

H2038.def: from the same as «02036»; a castle (from its height):--palace.

H2039.def: perhaps from «02022»; mountaineer; Haran, the name of two men:--Haran.

H2040.def: a primitive root; to pull down or in pieces, break, &Š destroy:--beat down, break (down, through), destroy, overthrow, pluck down, pull down, ruin, throw down, × utterly.

H2042.et: from an unused root meaning to loom up
H2042.def: from an unused root meaning to loom up; a mountain:--hill, mount(-ain).

H2043.def: or Harariy (2 Sam. 23:11) {haw-raw-ree'}; or Haarariy (2 Sam. 23:34, last clause), {haw-raw-ree'}; apparently from «02042»; a mountaineer:--Hararite.

H2044.def: perhaps from the same as «02828»; wealthy; Hashem, an Israelite:--Hashem.

H2047.def: probably of foreign origin; Hathak, a Persian eunuch:--Hatach.

H2048.def: a primitive root; to deride; by implication, to cheat:--deal deceitfully, deceive, mock.

H2049.def: from «02048» (only in plural collectively); a derision:--mocker.

H2050.def: a primitive root; properly, to break in upon, i.e. to assail:--imagine mischief.

H2051.def: perhaps for «05730»; Vedan (or Aden), a place in Arabia:--Dan also.

H2052.def: of uncertain derivation; Vaheb, a place in Moab:--what he did.

H2053.et: probably a hook (the name of the sixth Heb. letter)
H2053.def: probably a hook (the name of the sixth Heb. letter):--hook.

H2054.et: presumed to be from an unused root meaning to bear guilt
H2054.def: presumed to be from an unused root meaning to bear guilt; crime:--X strange.

H2055.def: of foreign origin; Vajezatha, a son of Haman:--Vajezatha.

H2058.def: probably from «03254»; additional; Vophsi, an &Š Israelite:--Vophsi.

H2059.def: probably from «03461»; weak; Vashni, an Israelite:--Vashni.

H2060.def: of Persian origin; Vashti, the queen of Xerxes:--Vashti.

H2061.et: from an unused root meaning to be yellow
H2061.def: from an unused root meaning to be yellow; a wolf:--wolf.

H2062.def: the same as «02061»; Zeeb, a Midianitish prince:--Zeeb.

H2063.def: irregular feminine of «02089»; this (often used adverb):-- hereby (-in, -with), it, likewise, the one (other, same), she, so (much), such (deed), that, therefore, these, this (thing), thus.

H2066.def: from «02064»; giver; Zabad, the name of seven Israelites:--Zabad.

H2067.def: from «02065»; giving; Zabdi, the name of four &Š Israelites:--Zabdi.

H2068.def: from «02065» and «0410»; gift of God: zabdiel, the name of two Israelites:--Zabdiel.

H2069.def: or Zbadyahuw {zeb-ad-yaw'-hoo}; from «02064» and «03050»; Jah has given; Zebadjah, the name of nine Israelites:--Zebadiah.

H2070.et: from an unused root (meaning to flit)
H2070.def: from an unused root (meaning to flit); a fly (especially one of a stinging nature):--fly.

H2072.def: a form of «02071»; given; Zabbud, an Israelite:--Zabbud.

H2073.def: or zbul {zeb-ool'}; from «02082»; a residence:--dwell in, dwelling, habitation.

H2074.def: or Zbuluwn {zeb-oo-loon'}; or Zbuwlun {zeb-oo-loon'}; from «02082»; habitation; Zebulon, a son of Jacob; also his territory and tribe:--Zebulun.

H2075.def: patronymically from «02074»; a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun:--Zebulonite.

H2076.def: a primitive root; to slaughter an animal (usually in sacrifice):--kill, offer, (do) sacrifice, slay.

H2077.def: from «02076»; properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act):--offer(- ing), sacrifice.

H2078.def: the same as «02077»; sacrifice; Zebach, a Midianitish prince:--Zebah.

H2079.def: probably by orthographical error for «02140»; Zabbai (or Zaccai), an Israelite:--Zabbai.

H2080.def: feminine from «02064»; giving; Zebidah, an Israelitess:--Zebudah.

H2081.et: from an unused root (meaning to purchase)
H2081.def: from an unused root (meaning to purchase); gainfulness; Zebina, an Israelite:--Zebina.

H2082.def: a primitive root; apparently properly, to inclose, i.e. to reside:--dwell with.

H2083.def: the same as «02073»; dwelling; Zebul, an Israelite:--Zebul. Compare «02073».

H2084.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of «02081»; to acquire by purchase:--gain.

H2085.et: from an unused root probably meaning to inclose
H2085.def: from an unused root probably meaning to inclose; the skin of a grape:--husk.

H2088.def: a primitive word; the masculine demonstrative pronoun, this or that:--he, × hence, × here, it(-self), × now, × of him, the one...the other, × than the other, (X out of) the (self) same, such (a one) that, these, this (hath, man), on this side...on that side, × thus, very, which. Compare «02063», «02090», «02097», «02098».

H2089.def: (1 Samuel by permutation for «07716»; a sheep:--lamb.

H2090.def: for «02088»; this or that:--as well as another, it, this, that, thus and thus.

H2091.et: from an unused root meaning to shimmer
H2091.def: from an unused root meaning to shimmer; gold, figuratively, something gold-colored (i.e. yellow), as oil, a clear sky:-- gold(-en), fair weather.

H2092.def: a primitive root; to be rancid, i.e. (transitively) to loathe:--abhor.

H2094.def: a primitive root; to gleam; figuratively, to enlighten (by caution):--admonish, shine, teach, (give) warn(-ing).

H2098.def: for «02088»; this or that:--that, this, × wherein, which, whom.

H2099.et: probably from an unused root meaning to be prominent
H2099.def: probably from an unused root meaning to be prominent; properly, brightness (compare «02122»), i.e. (figuratively) the month of flowers; Ziv (corresponding to Ijar or May):--Zif.
